title: Financial Mathematics: Interest, Tax and Discounts
introduction: Consolidate primary mathematics and prepare for secondary study through financial mathematics: interest, tax and discounts.
definition: Simple interest is calculated only on the original principal. Express the annual interest rate as a decimal and the duration in years. Taxes and discounts are calculated from the specified price base; determine whether they are added or subtracted.

formulas.description: Simple interest, annual decimal rate r and time t in years.

examples.question: Find simple interest on RM800 at 5% per year for 2 years.
An item costs RM150 before a hypothetical 8% tax.

exercises.question: Simple interest on RM500 at 4% for 3 years, RM?
Total after simple interest on RM1000 at 3% for 2 years, RM?
RM200 item discounted 15%, final price RM?
RM80 plus hypothetical 5% tax, total RM?
Cost RM150, sold RM180. Profit percentage number?
Simple interest on RM1200 at 6% for 6 months, RM?

summary: Simple interest is calculated only on the original principal. Express the annual interest rate as a decimal and the duration in years. Taxes and discounts are calculated from the specified price base; determine whether they are added or subtracted.
